headline: The FBI’s Springfield Field Office is now leading the investigation into an explosive device found at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois. The FBI said it has confirmed an explosive device was found, and it’s working with ATF, Illinois State Police and local agencies to identify those responsible. According to authorities, Peoria Police were called to the facility just after 1 p.m. Friday. A suspicious device was located about 2 p.m. and deemed credible at 6:45 p.m. An evacuation of everyone within one mile followed just after 7 p.m. The device was rendered safe at 9:12 p.m. The search for additional devices continued until about 1 p.m. Saturday, when the order was lifted. No other devices were found. The evacuation lasted about 18 hours and affected thousands of people and spanned parts of downtown Peoria, the Warehouse District and East Peoria.

headline: U.S. intelligence analysts assess that Iran has between 1,500 and 2,500 missiles, U.S. officials told The Wall Street Journal. It is a low confidence estimate because of the difficulty of tracking how many are ready for launch or in storage. Israeli military officials assess Iran has more than 1,500 ballistic missiles. The Journal says the assessment stand in contrast to statements from administration officials, including President Donald J. Trump, that Iran’s military was decimated, and has informed internal discussions about resuming strikes. headline: The incident at the BioUrja ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois remains very active this morning. Peoria Police Chief Brad Dixon said at an overnight press conference that one device has been rendered safe, but the rest of the facility has not been cleared and the search will continue throughout much of today. Chief Dixon confirmed that a device was found Friday afternoon after the plant reported a bomb threat. Chief Dixon reiterated that the threat is credible and the incident is still active. He would not confirm whether more than one device has been located. The FBI and ATF are on scene assisting Peoria authorities. A one mile evacuation zone around the plant on Edmund Street remains in effect across parts of Peoria and East Peoria, with more than 5,000 people reportedly evacuated. About 75 people are sheltering at Manual Academy. The next scheduled update is at noon. The timeline of events as relayed by the Chief: 1:08p.m - BioUrja contacted Peoria Police in reference to a bomb threat 2:00p.m. (approximately) - A suspicious device was located and additional resources requested to the scene 6:45p.m. - Device determined to be credible and a 1 mile blast radius was established 7:02p.m - Mass notification ordering evacuation within the 1 mile blast radius sent 9:12p.m. - Device rendered safe
